faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: If you still have any doubts, talk to us.

items.a: It's a financial control platform that helps you organize expenses, cards, bills, goals, income and investments in one place, with a simple and easy-to-understand view.

items.q: Do I need to understand finance to use it?
items.a: No. The system was designed to be simple and visual, even for people who don't understand much about finance.

items.q: Can I manage cards and statements?
items.a: Yes. You track purchases, statements, due dates, used limit and statement payment all in one place.

items.q: Can I separate expenses by reference month?
items.a: Yes. The system uses a reference month, so you decide which month each expense belongs to — perfect for statements and bills paid in one month but referring to another.

items.q: Does the system help with financial goals?
items.a: Yes. You create goals, track how much has been set aside, how much is left and visualize your progress toward each objective.

items.q: Is there a plan for freelancers?
items.a: Yes. We have Essential and Complete plans for freelancers, with language and features built for your business, plus the Business plan for those who need more control.

items.q: What's in the Smart Business area?
items.a: You register your company by tax ID, register clients and suppliers, link income, expenses and bills to each one, view reports per client and per supplier, and generate the Accountant Package with the monthly summary.

items.q: Does the Accountant Package replace my accountant?
items.a: No. It organizes monthly information for you to send to your accountant — with income, expenses, pending items and comparison with the previous month. Accounting is still done by the professional.
It's a quick panel with USD, EUR, Selic and IPCA so you can follow the scenario and understand the economy's impact on your money.

items.q: Can I access it from my phone?
items.a: Yes. Gasto Inteligente is fully responsive and works great on phone, tablet and computer, directly from the browser.
Dark/light mode is available inside the user's logged area. The public landing page uses a light visual to ease readability.
Click "Get started" at the top of the page, create your account for free and choose the plan that suits you.
